Title: AdGuard hides product search controls
Preconditions:
1. AdGuard is enabled with its default filtering configuration.
2. The Products page is open in a desktop browser.
Steps:
1. Enable AdGuard.
2. Open https://www.automationexercise.com/products
3. Locate the "All Products" section.
4. Check whether the product search controls are displayed.
5. Disable AdGuard for automationexercise.com.
6. Refresh the page.
Expected Result:
The product search controls should remain visible and functional when
advertising content is blocked because they are part of the core product
functionality and are not advertisements.
Actual Result:
When AdGuard is enabled, the "Search Product" input field and search
button are not displayed. The controls appear after AdGuard is disabled
for the website.
